en.headline: Immigration Department extends APEC Business Travel Card stay to 90 days from today
en.dek: Holders who have obtained pre-clearance from Hong Kong can now stay visa-free for up to 90 days, up from 60, aligning with the Mainland's implementation date.
body: The Immigration Department said that from 1 November 2026, the maximum visa-free period of stay in Hong Kong for holders of the APEC Business Travel Card who have obtained pre-clearance from the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region will be extended from 60 days to 90 days.

An Immigration Department spokesman said the APEC Business Mobility Group had announced that five participating economies — the People's Republic of China; Hong Kong, China; Indonesia; the Philippines; and Singapore — would extend the maximum stay for visiting cardholders to 90 days. The Mainland is implementing the change from 1 November, and Hong Kong is aligning with that date. Other immigration arrangements for the card remain unchanged.

Nineteen economies currently participate in the scheme. Cardholders who have obtained pre-clearance from participating economies are entitled to a visa-free stay of no less than 60 days and may use special service lanes at selected control points. The card is normally valid for five years.

zh.headline: 入境處由今日起將APEC商務旅遊證免簽逗留期延至90天
zh.dek: 已獲香港特區預先審批的持證人最長免簽證逗留期限由60天延長至90天，與內地實施日期一致。
body: 入境事務處表示，由2026年11月1日起，已獲香港特別行政區預先審批的亞太經合組織商務旅遊證持有人，在港最長可免簽證逗留期限由60天延長至90天。
入境處發言人指，亞太經合組織商務人員流動專家組已宣布，為進一步發揮商務旅遊證效用，中國內地、中國香港、印尼、菲律賓及新加坡五個參與經濟體將放寬到訪當地持證人的最長逗留期限至90天。中國內地由11月1日起實施新安排，香港特區與國家實施日期一致。其他有關商務旅遊證持有人進入香港的入境安排則維持不變。
現時參與計劃的經濟體共有19個。已獲預先審批的持證人前往相關經濟體時可免簽證逗留不少於60天，並可使用指定管制站的特別服務通道辦理快捷入境。商務旅遊證有效期一般為五年。
